title: IPC admin.trust.seed params
description: Give one configured endpoint its own trust set from what it admits now, if it has none (IPC 3.0, ADR-0067 decision 6, LOCAL-IPC.md §The endpoint dimension): the copy `admin.trust.set {endpoint}` makes at a first write, per direction, with no change after it. `endpoint` is the EndpointId of a configured endpoint, authored or added, enabled or not; a value outside the grammar is `InvalidArgument`, an id no entry holds `EndpointUnknown`, and the alias is not accepted (a client resolves it). Required, and nothing else is accepted.
